en.behaviorSettings.title: Startup, files and accessibility
en.behaviorSettings.description: Defaults for startup sessions, SFTP behavior and terminal accessibility.
en.behaviorSettings.startupBookmarksHint: Select up to 20 bookmarks. Hold Ctrl or Command to select more than one.
en.behaviorSettings.startupWorkspaceHint: The selected named workspace takes priority over last-layout restoration.
en.behaviorSettings.refreshOnFocus: Refresh local and remote files when opening SFTP
en.behaviorSettings.followTerminalCwd: Keep the SFTP path synchronized with the SSH terminal
en.behaviorSettings.sshSplitView: Open SSH file management in split view
en.behaviorSettings.systemEditor: Leave blank to use the system default
en.behaviorSettings.externalEditorHint: Use an absolute executable path. Axterm passes the authorized temporary file as one argument without invoking a shell.
en.behaviorSettings.screenReaderHint: Updates open xterm sessions immediately and applies to every new terminal.
en.tabPreferences.title: Tab behavior
en.tabPreferences.description: Session numbers and hover switching apply immediately to every pane.
en.tabPreferences.restoreLayout: Restore the saved layout on startup
